title: Cancellation of Art Stage Singapore Shortly before Opening
what_it_is: Cancellation of Art Stage Singapore Shortly before Opening

sections.label: ARTery art fair support
sections.summary: Art Outreach organised ARTery, supported by NAC, STB and EDB, and contacted 36 affected exhibitors including all without alternative space in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To help the gallerists and artists affected by the cancellation, a non-profit organisation, Art Outreach, organised a new art fair called ARTery, which NAC, STB and EDB supported.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We understand that Art Outreach contacted 36 affected exhibitors, including all who had no alternative space in Singapore.

sections.label: Sector resilience and viability
sections.summary: The sector is resilient and deep enough to overcome the disappointment, and Singapore remains a viable location for art fairs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: However, the sector is sufficiently resilient and deep to overcome this disappointment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We believe that Singapore remains a viable location for art fairs.

sections.label: Late cancellation disruption
sections.summary: The cancellation occurred eight days before the event, making it very disruptive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The issue with the cancellation was that it occurred eight days before the event, so it was very disruptive.

sections.label: Singapore Art Week participation
sections.summary: Participation and collector visits at Singapore Art Week shows have been increasing in good numbers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As we have seen in the Singapore Art Week, the number of people participating, the number of collectors visiting our shows have actually been increasing in good numbers.

sections.label: Early warning system disappointment
sections.summary: MCCY and NAC were particularly disappointed because they had presented Singapore Art Week with Art Stage, a commercial organisation whose financial numbers they do not see.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Whether there will be an early warning system, I would say that the reason why MCCY and NAC were particularly disappointed with this cancellation is because we have had occasions where we presented Singapore Art Week to the community together with Art Stage.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier on, Art Stage is a commercial organisation and we do not have sight of its financial numbers.

sections.label: NAC no financial interest
sections.summary: NAC has no direct financial interest in the show, so it would not be appropriate to demand commercial organisations show their financial situations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: NAC does not have a direct financial interest in the show, so it would not be appropriate for us to be demanding commercial organisations to show us their financial situations.
